caption: The drawing depicts a stylized figure of a crucified person on a wooden cross. The cross is brown with blocks of yellow, red, and black at the ends, featuring repeated letters "BB" in black and red within the color blocks. The figure is shown with outstretched arms and crossed feet, attached to the cross. The skin of the figure is depicted in shades of tan, brown, and beige, with prominent red and black markings to suggest wounds, muscles, and blood. The head has a halo or crown of thorns illustrated as a black and yellow spiked circle, with red marks on the face and black hair. The torso and limbs are marked in red to emphasize ribs, muscles, and wounds; the knees and side also show multiple circular red markings. The hips are covered with a beige loincloth featuring a black and red circular symbol at the center. The drawing is made with bold lines and contrasting colors, mainly red, brown, yellow, black, and tan. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. The number "27" is printed in small blue text in the bottom-left corner outside the central image.
title: Plate 27: Christ Crucified: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
